messages:
Priya (Design): quick sync 1 1 question: for the new 'Create API Key' modal, do we show errors as users type or wait until they leave a field? Ethan (Eng): strong vote for not validating on every keystroke. onChange validation kills UX for fields like description. onBlur for format checks, submit for cross-field. Maria (PM): product constraint: users often hit an error when they paste big payloads. we need clear entry points to fix things fast. Lina (Frontend): pattern I like: show minimal passive validation (icon) while typing, full inline message onBlur, and a sticky error summary on submit that traps focus. avoids noisy pop-ins. Noor (Research): in testing, users liked a visible required marker. they expect '*' and an optional label for the rest. hiding 'required' entirely confused some participants. Priya (Design): proposal: visible asterisk + small label for optional fields. validation: onBlur for inline errors with short remediation copy, submit shows summary at top with linkable anchors. a11y-bot: reminder: error text must be programmatically associated via aria-describedby; do not encode error states using color alone. ensure 4.5:1 contrast for error text. Ethan (Eng): implementation note: for the anchor summary, we should add tabindex=-1 and focus() on it so screen readers jump. and we need unique ids for each error block. Lina (Frontend): sanity code snippet for input binding: ```
Must be 3-50 chars
``` Maria (PM): destructive confirmation behavior: deleting an API key 8% of users reported accidental deletes9 1 maybe typed-confirm? Noor (Research): typed-confirm is strong protection but a pain at scale. recommendation: tiered approach: typed-confirm for org-level keys or keys with active delegations; modal + undo for normal keys. Priya (Design): agree. also propose default focus in modal on 'Cancel' to avoid accidental confirms, and make primary destructive button red with label 'Delete key' rather than just 'Delete'. Ethan (Eng): small accessibility nit: ensure the undo toast is keyboard accessible and has a clear aria-live announcement. a11y-bot: checklist: focus trap in modal, initial focus on cancel, role=dialog with aria-labelledby, ensure undo toast is reachable via keyboard and has aria-live=polite. Lina (Frontend): UX copy: replace 'Invalid input' with 'Key name must only contain letters, numbers, -, or _ and be 3 6 characters.' actionable and scannable. Priya (Design): decision recap: 1) show '*' for required + '(optional)' on others 2) validate onBlur for inline checks, full validation on submit with linked summary 3) use aria-describedby/aria-invalid and role=alert for errors 4) tiered destructive confirmations (typed-confirm only for highest risk) 5) copy = explicit remediation. Maria (PM): I'll put these in the ticket acceptance criteria. Noor (Research): I'll run a 6-user quick test next week to confirm the onBlur + summary flow. Ethan (Eng): OK I'll add small helpers to the form library: id generation, focus-to-summary util, aria helpers. target next sprint. Priya (Design): thanks all. posting updated mockups in #design after edits. :sparkles: Lina (Frontend): :+1:
